page: Hetzner Cloud cx23 is an entry-level virtual server utilizing the QEMU hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. It features 2 shared vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.0 GHz. The processor includes 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, supported by a cache hierarchy of 32 KB L1d, 4 MB L2, and 16 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 4.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 1.95 GB of memory per core, and includes 40 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. No GPU resources are included.

Benchmark evaluations place the cx23 in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests score 1028.88 and 2016.78 respectively, both falling into the bottom 10% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth is similarly constrained, with read-only large block transfers registering at 20.91 GB/sec and write large block transfers at 16.93 GB/sec. Database operations, such as Redis SET, achieve 2.52 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput reaches 1.77 GB/sec.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest hardware profile, the cx23 represents a highly cost-efficient option for lightweight, non-critical workloads where resource density and low overhead are prioritized over raw compute power. It is suited for basic web serving, development environments, lightweight background tasks, and small-scale testing.
